cases.title: Supplier invoice diversion — Aster Office Supplies
cases.description: Fictional demo: an accounts clerk reports a ₹4,80,000 supplier payment redirected after an altered invoice arrived by email. Compare the message headers, payment authorization and workstation findings; the allegation remains under investigation.

cases.title: Night-time collision — Riverside Junction
cases.description: Fictional demo: a delivery rider reports a night-time collision at Riverside Junction. Correlate camera timing, a witness account and scene notes. A later camera transcript differs from the preserved original, providing an integrity-alert scenario.

cases.title: Missing stock — Meridian Logistics warehouse
cases.description: Fictional demo: twenty-four handheld scanners were reported missing after a loading-bay shift. Review access logs, the stock discrepancy and a final examination note. The case is closed for demonstration after an inventory reconciliation, with evidence retained.

cases.title: Ransomware incident — Community Skills Centre
cases.description: Fictional demo: a training centre reports unavailable shared files and an extortion message on one workstation. Preserve the incident log, endpoint timeline and triage note while examining the entry point and recovery options. No malware is included.
